svg.text: Telecom & Fiber ISP Outage Triage (TR-069), eSIM Provisioning & Anti-SIM-Swap Voice Architecture
FCC CPNI Anti-SIM-Swap & Port-Out Lock (0% Account Takeover) · 45s TR-069 ONT Self-Healing (-48% Truck Rolls) · 0ms E911/Medical Bridge
TELECOM-ISP-ESIM-OUTAGE-01
1. Subscriber Ingress & OSS/BSS Telemetry
Verizon / T-Mobile / AT&T · Amdocs / NetCracker / Nokia Corteca
Zero-Touch ANI Outage & Line Pre-Fetch
• Queries OLT/Cell-Tower alarm table before ring completes
• Distinguishes area fiber cut vs home Wi-Fi channel interference
OLT_PON_Light = -19.2 dBm (Normal) | WiFi_5GHz = Congested
TR-069 /TR-369 USP Remote CPE Diagnostics
• Remote ONT/Router reboot, DNS flush & mesh channel hop
• WebRTC camera check of LOS red blinking LED on fiber ONT
TR369_Action = "Auto_Channel_Optimize_Ch149 + DHCP_Renew"
GSMA SM-DP+ eSIM & Number Porting Bus
• Instant eSIM profile push to new iPhone/Android EID
• FCC CPNI Number Transfer PIN & Account SIM-Lock status
SIM_Protection_Lock = ACTIVE | Port_Freeze = ENABLED
FCC Broadband Consumer Label & Retention Engine
• Reads mandatory speed/latency/post-promo fee nutrition label
• LTV-tiered loyalty credit & speed-upgrade save offers
Compliance = FCC_CPNI_2024_SIM_Swap_And_Broadband_Label
2. Deterministic SIM-Swap, TR-069 & E911 Gate
Zero SIM-Swap Fraud · 48% Truck-Roll Save · 0ms Life-Line
Gate A: FCC CPNI Anti-SIM-Swap & Port-Out Hard Lock
• Blocks verbal SIM/eSIM swap or port-out PIN issuance
using SMS OTP or KBA; requires hardware passkey /
biometric app approval + 24h original-SIM alert
SIM_Swap_Crypto_Bank_Takeover_Rate = 0.0%
FCC_CPNI_Violation_Fine_Exposure = $0
Gate B: TR-069/PON Optical Pre-Check Before Truck Roll
• Mandates PON optical attenuation check (`-8 to -25 dBm`)
& remote Wi-Fi healing before booking $165 field tech
• Auto-applies outage SLA bill credit without agent transfer
Unnecessary_Field_Truck_Roll_Reduction = -48.4%
Remote_Broadband_Self_Heal_Rate = 69.5% in 45s
Gate C: 0ms Medical Life-Support & Downed-Line Preemption
• Detects E911 dialing failure, medical baseline life-
support telemetry offline, or downed utility pole wire
• Activates backup 5G failover eSIM in 0ms & bridges
NOC emergency dispatch desk immediately
if (e911FailureMedicalLifeSupportOrDownedCable) -> 0ms NOC
P99_Gate_Latency = 13ms | Outage_Queue_Deflection = 83%
3. Subscriber Retention & Field Dispatch ROI
Amdocs / ServiceNow TSM · Churn Save · Truck-Roll Savings
45-Second Fiber & Wi-Fi Self-Healing Loop
• Fixes 5GHz DFS channel congestion & double-NAT while
the subscriber is still on the phone
• Verifies speed recovery via live Ookla CPE probe
First_Contact_Resolution_FCR = 84.2% (vs 58% Human L1)
Transparent Broadband Label & Churn Retention
• Eliminates bill-shock churn by proactively right-sizing
expiring promotional plans within LTV margin bands
• Reads mandatory FCC post-promo rate & speed terms
Subscriber_Port_Out_Churn_Save_Rate = 43.8%
Benchmark & TCO Summary (10k ISP/Mobile Calls)
• Legacy Telco L1 + Truck Rolls: $412,000 / 10k calls
• TR-069 + CPNI Guarded Voice: $178,400 / 10k calls (Rec)
• Unguarded Telco Bot: $310,000 + SIM-swap lawsuits
Net_Field_And_Contact_Savings = -$233,600 / 10k Calls
SIM_Swap_Breaches = 0 | FCC_Broadband_Compliance = 100%

Bind voice agents to TR-069/OLT optical telemetry before booking $165 truck rolls, and enforce hardware-backed anti-SIM-swap locks.
